title: Chapter 640
text:
Fawn Star System, Planet Capolodi.

The ruler of this planet was the Vinstark Civilization. It was a planet-level regime that belonged to the Black Raven Civilization. The Vinstark race was an intelligent species with feathers and wings. They were born with the ability to fly. The buildings on Planet Capolodi reached into the clouds. They looked like trees on the outside with long, branch-like platforms hanging outside.

The Vinstark Civilization was peaceful and lazy, willing to be a vassal of the Black Raven Civilization. Therefore, they were troubled by dissidents and extreme nationalists, and new rebel organizations would pop up every few days. In the entire universe, such examples were as common as the stars.

A team from the Sky Ring Army accepted an invitation to eliminate a rebel organization called 'Bullseye'.

The leader of the team was [Ice Mage] Goa, a three-ring officer, Grade B Super. She had once fought alongside Black Star on Floating Dragon Island. She had always been active around the Fawn Star System.

According to Vinstark's information, the strongest person in the Bullseye organization was only a Grade B. This was supposed to be a regular combat mission, but Goa did not expect that there would be a Grade A Super hidden in the Bullseye organization. Furthermore, he was not a nobody but a member of the Vinstark race that he had exiled many years ago. His name was Getorald.

Now that he had become a Calamity Grade, he wanted to come back and overthrow Vinstark's rule. Not only was he the real master of the Bullseye organization, he was also the mastermind behind many other rebel organizations. He was the big boss of the rebel forces on Planet Capolodi.

In a certain wilderness, a small aircraft was escaping at high speed. Hundreds of aircraft were chasing behind it, creating a raging wind and dust.

"The people from the Bullseye organization have found us again. We've been hiding for so long, and we don't have much fuel left. Leader, what should we do?"

In the cockpit, the surviving members of the Sky Ring Army hurriedly operated the aircraft. Someone asked loudly.

"Continue to escape. I've already applied for support from the Black Star Corps. Black Star's reinforcements will definitely come. We have to hold on until then."

Goa clenched her teeth. Her magic robe was covered in blood and dust. After so many days of escaping, her condition was extremely bad, and she was extremely tired.

She had only fought with Getorald once, and she had been beaten black and blue. She could not cross the gap between Grade B and A. If not for her good luck, the team would have been wiped out long ago.

The fuel was quickly used up, and the speed gradually slowed down. The pursuers surrounded them, and the distance kept shortening. All the Sky Ring mercenaries had their hearts in their throats. Goa could not help but grip her staff tightly.

At this moment, a communication request popped up on the screen, and Lagi's dejected face appeared.

"Hey, hey, your reinforcements have arrived. Is there anyone alive? If not, I'm leaving."

Everyone was overjoyed. Goa quickly replied, "We're still alive. The situation is very dangerous now, and we need help urgently. The coordinates are …"

After reporting the coordinates, Lagi hung up the call. Everyone heaved a sigh of relief and smiled.

"Black Star's reinforcements have finally arrived!"

"That's great! We're saved!"

Goa suddenly realized a problem. "Wait, I told them that the enemy has a Calamity Grade. Why wasn't it Black Star himself? Did he not come personally? "

Everyone's expression changed slightly. They all knew the Black Star Corps quite well and knew that only Black Star was a Calamity Grade. They had never heard of the Black Star Corps having any other Grade A combatants.

Goa could not help but worry. She only hoped that the reinforcements were reliable.

All of a sudden, everyone's hair stood on end. They saw a powerful Shockwave Blast shoot out horizontally, hitting their aircraft at an angle.

Boom!

Violent vibration, violent explosion!

The aircraft exploded into pieces, and a spherical magic shield was blown away. It bounced a few times on the ground before stopping. The magic shield disappeared, and Goa's figure was revealed. The staff in her hand was shining brightly. She had protected all her team members at the last moment. She was so tired that she was panting, and she looked tired.

This time, hundreds of enemy aircraft caught up and surrounded Goa and the others.

In the direction where the shockwave came from, a birdman flew over at high speed and hovered above them. His eagle-like eyes looked down at them coldly, as sharp as knives. This bird was the Grade A Super of the rebel organization, Getorald.

"Humph, people from Sky Ring. I hate mercenaries the most. If you want to blame someone, blame yourselves for interfering with something that has nothing to do with you. You deserve to die."

Getorald flapped his wings, and a ball of high-density platinum Pugilist energy gathered in his palm. The strong sense of danger made Goa and the others freeze.

Hu!

Just as Getorald was about to kill them, a spaceship broke through the clouds in the sky and flew over. He could not help but turn around and look.

The spaceship stopped outside the encirclement. The cabin door opened, and Lagi slowly floated out. Seeing the dangerous situation Goa and the others were in, his expression turned bitter.

"I'm early …"

Getorald frowned. "Who are you?"

Before Lagi could speak, Goa answered first.

"You're dead. He's our reinforcements, from the Black Star Corps … Er, what's your name?" Goa only then realized that she did not know the name of the reinforcements.

Lagi sighed. "Ask for my name again, and I'm leaving."

"Black Star's people?" Hearing their conversation, Getorald's pupils constricted. Sh * t.

He was not afraid of the Sky Ring Army because Sky Ring's base was very far away. However, the Garton Star System was right next to the Fawn Star System. He only felt that it was extremely troublesome and was very wary of the Black Star Corps.

Especially the name Black Star, Getorald had heard of Black Star before. Black Star's position in the Colton Star Cluster was way higher than his.

With a heavy heart, Getorald thought about what to do.

"The Black Star Corps is already involved. My plan can't continue. I can only kill this Black Star mercenary and leave the Colton Star Cluster to hide. If I continue to stay here, the Black Star Corps will send a large number of troops to deal with me sooner or later. Luckily, only one person came from Black Star this time. After killing him and the people from Sky Ring, I can hide the news for a while and have time to escape."

With that in mind, Getorald made a decisive decision and ordered loudly.

"Everyone, fire! Kill these Sky Ring mercenaries!"

The expressions of Goa and the others changed drastically. They hurriedly used all kinds of defensive abilities. They were in a very bad state. Once they were focused on, they would either die or be heavily injured.

The cannons of all the spaceships lit up, and the cannons were about to fire.

Getorald turned around and charged toward Lagi, turning into a meteor surrounded by flames. He used his full power right from the start.

At this moment, Lagi sighed. An ancient staff appeared in his hand out of thin air, and he gently tapped the air.

"Space-Time Secret Spell — Seventh Dimension."

Hum!

An invisible barrier suddenly spread out, enveloping all the individuals present. At this moment, all movements within the barrier came to a standstill, as if time and space had frozen. Every single one of them

Everyone's expression froze.

However, everyone's thoughts were still there. They could clearly feel the feeling of their bodies freezing, but they could not control their bodies. Getorald was also frozen in midair, unable to move. His heart was in turmoil.

Han Technician, who was peeping, almost spat out the snacks in his mouth.

Isn't this f * cking Waludo?

Space-Time Secret Spell was the most difficult Magic Style to master, and it was very dangerous. When the caster was studying it, they might not even have a corpse left if they were not careful. It required extremely high talent.

Not everyone could become the hunting target of Albert and the others. Lagi was not a member of any large organization; he was just a lone ranger. Therefore, there was only one reason why Lagi was targeted …

That was because of his strength!

In this space-time domain, only Lagi could move freely. He continuously cast spells and destroyed all the spaceships. At this moment, Getorald finally broke free from the restriction of the spell. Without saying anything, he turned around and ran away like a meteor.

His confidence was shattered by Lagi's one move.

Lagi did not chase after him. His mission was to save the Sky Ring mercenaries. He did not want to waste energy chasing after an opponent of the same level. He floated in front of Goa and the others, sighing. "Get on my ship and leave this place."

Goa quickly nodded to maintain her respect for the strong. She could not help but ask, "Are you a new officer of the Black Star Corps? I've never heard of your name before."

"It's best if you never hear of it." Lagi's expression collapsed.

The other Sky Ring mercenaries looked at each other and were shocked. The Black Star Corps finally had its first Calamity Grade officer, and he was so strong. It was no longer Black Star alone. They felt that their Sky Ring Army was being surpassed by the Black Star Corps very quickly.

Goa had complicated feelings. She still remembered that a few years ago, Black Star was just a small mercenary group, and she was a captain of Sky Ring. Their strength was about the same, and she had the background of Sky Ring, so her position was higher than Black Star's.

However, she was still the captain of Sky Ring, and Black Star was already a big shot in the Colton Star Cluster. He had a place in the entire Shattered Star Ring. The difference in strength and position between the two of them was like heaven and earth.

Without comparison, there would be no harm. With Black Star as an example, Goa felt that she had been standing on the same spot for the past few years. She could not help but feel discouraged.

At the same time, on the other side of the Observer's Mark, Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. He stroked his stubble and could not help but smile.

"Looks like I've found a treasure …"

…

A few days later, the festival of the second season finally came to an end.

The eight teams in the finals attracted the most attention since the start of the competition. The supporters of each team were very passionate, waving their flags and cheering.

In the first round, Dynasty defeated Rivervale. Dynasty entered the semifinals, and Rivervale stopped in the top eight. This result was expected by almost everyone.

Long Sky fought with Kimchi, and they defeated Kimchi three to one. Kimchi was eliminated, and Long Sky successfully entered the semifinals.

Two Chinese teams entered the semifinals, and the Chinese viewers could not help but look forward to seeing the Chinese teams meet in the finals.

Unfortunately, in the second round of the draw, Dynasty drew Long Sky as their opponent, while Devil was up against Tomahawk.

The Chinese players sighed in pity. Dynasty was so unlucky. After entering the finals, they both faced Chinese teams in the first and second round.

The second round was very intense, and the peak was right in front of them. Neither Dynasty nor Long Sky would give in. They fought until their heads bled, and countless viewers were worried.

Many people predicted that Dynasty would have a higher chance of winning, but the result was unexpected. Under Hao Tian's lead, Long Sky showed amazing resilience and defeated Dynasty three to two, successfully entering the finals.

Dynasty stopped in the top four, and they could only fight for third place.

After the match, many reporters interviewed Dynasty, but King Admiral did not have any regrets.

"We've spent too much energy in the previous matches. Hao Tian is an old rival of mine, and he did really well this time. I'm convinced of my loss. I hope that they can bring back a championship trophy for China. Brother, you've won my spot in the finals, so you have to do your best. Flame them as much as you can, so they won't dare to lose. They don't have to give me face."

A reporter with bad intentions mentioned King Admiral's words during the Regular Season, wanting to embarrass him. However, King Admiral did not care at all and laughed at himself.

"I wanted to teach the other teams a lesson, but I didn't expect to be taught a lesson by my fellow countrymen. That's fine too. I didn't go back on my words when I lost to my own team. Hao Tian, you have to win the championship. At least using the excuse of losing to the champion will make me less flame."

All the reporters laughed, and even the reporter who asked the question could not help but laugh.

Soon, it was Second Prince's turn to be interviewed. Second Prince's speech was in accordance with his usual style. He said casually, "It's definitely the captain's fault for losing the competition. This proves that we should change the captain. Other than me, there's no need to consider anyone else. King Admiral should retire. He's just a greasy middle-aged man.

Dynasty's interview was very lively, and it slightly diluted the regret of the Chinese audience. All the hope and pressure were placed on Long Sky.

Originally, Dynasty was the team with the highest chance of winning the championship, but Long Sky had defeated them. If they did not win the championship in the end, the outcome would be obvious.

However, not only did Hao Tian not panic, his fighting spirit was even higher.

Since the start of the competition, Dynasty had been in the limelight, and he led Long Sky to silently recharge, as if he was polishing a sword.

In the final match, the sword was finally unsheathed!

Everyone in Long Sky's team unleashed all their accumulated passion and momentum, and they had the strong confidence to cut through everything!

Their opponent was Devil, who had defeated Tomahawk and entered the finals.

Devil was the second most popular team after Dynasty. They were like the final boss, the last obstacle between China and the world championship!

Tens of millions of players in the nine regions watched the finals together, and the final celebration was unprecedented.

Even Han Xiao put down what he was doing and watched the finals with all the players.

Looking at the intense battle between the two teams, his heart pumped hot blood, and it flowed through his veins. His emotions fluctuated according to the situation of the competition. For a moment, it was as if he had returned to the time when he was cheering for the Chinese teams and had to leave in disappointment.

The final score was three to two.

The last contestant from the Devil Realm fell on the arena.

Devil had fallen.

Long Sky was still standing.

The final victory belonged to Long Sky, to the Chinese teams!

"World Champion!"

At this moment, the Chinese players were extremely excited.
